clothing.open_haori_rule: Dark presentation/mannequin fill inside the garment opening is rejected; open areas must expose inner layers/body.
clothing.remaining_gate: Manual per-facing scale, cuff/hand seam and near/far sleeve correction against the dressed benchmark using canonical game facings.

waist.reason: The clothing reference contains presentation-baked pouch/gourd/charm content in several facings.

hair.blocker: source-level scalp art still requires manual polish

equipment.method: tight source rows plus component-based assignment; neighboring fragments are rejected

rules.source_isolation: Reject neighboring-item pixels, labels, panel borders, presentation shadows, unrelated direction art, opaque sheet background, and opaque interior presentation fill.
rules.paper_doll_anchor: All character layers share the 480x640 anatomical body lattice; do not independently center or bottom-justify them.
rules.occlusion: No garment or equipment layer may hide anatomy unless that occlusion is facing-specific and supported by the approved dressed Kairo benchmark.
rules.direction: Canonical gameplay S is front-facing and N is back-facing. Raw source slots are resolved only through explicit mapping metadata.
rules.runtime_gate: No 48x64 derivation until direction mapping is canonical, the clean-chest and hairless body masters pass, clothing seams are corrected, waist accessories are fully modular, equipment is registered, the four canonical SW equipment gaps are authored, and the complete source composite passes review.
